text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin and her friends were born 
differently, live differently, and run 
differently. ...And so are their reasons 
for running, and reasons to cheer for 
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Ines Fujin say that she runs 
simply because she wants to run right now, 
you tell her, "There's nothing wrong with 
that."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not about burdening her with 
expectations. I simply want to see her 
race her heart out, having fun, and 
running free.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pure cheers of support reach Ines Fujin. 
She knows full well how much strength they 
give her. Let's enjoy the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) to the absolute fullest!
